milestones.title: Formal definition — normalization
milestones.milestone_description: The Zipf distribution on $N$ elements assigns to rank $k$ the probability $f(k;N,s)=\frac{1}{H_{N,s}}\frac1{k^s}$, where $H_{N,s}$ is the normalization constant (source, \"Formal definition\").

milestones.title: Infobox — cumulative distribution function
milestones.milestone_description: The CDF of the Zipf distribution at $k$ is $H_{k,s}/H_{N,s}$ (source, infobox).

milestones.title: Infobox — mean
milestones.milestone_description: The mean of the Zipf distribution is $H_{N,s-1}/H_{N,s}$ (source, infobox).

milestones.title: Infobox — variance
milestones.milestone_description: The variance of the Zipf distribution is $\frac{H_{N,s-2}}{H_{N,s}}-\frac{H_{N,s-1}^2}{H_{N,s}^2}$ (source, infobox).

milestones.title: Infobox — entropy
milestones.milestone_description: The entropy of the Zipf distribution is $\frac{s}{H_{N,s}}\sum_{k=1}^N\frac{\ln k}{k^s}+\ln(H_{N,s})$ (source, infobox).

milestones.title: Infobox — mode
milestones.milestone_description: The mode of the Zipf distribution is $1$ (source, infobox, parameter range $s\ge0$).

milestones.title: Lead — rank-frequency ratio
milestones.milestone_description: The most common word occurs about $n$ times the $n$-th most common one (exponent $s$ close to $1$; source, \"Word frequencies in human languages\" and lead section).

milestones.title: Empirical testing — log–log linearity
milestones.milestone_description: Plotted on a log–log graph (log rank, log frequency), Zipf's law with exponent $s$ is an affine function with slope $-s$ (source, \"Empirical testing\").

milestones.title: Related laws — Zipf–Mandelbrot law
milestones.milestone_description: The Zipf–Mandelbrot law has frequencies $f(k;N,q,s)=\frac1C\frac1{(k+q)^s}$, where the constant $C$ is the Hurwitz zeta function evaluated at $s$ (source, \"Related laws\").

milestones.title: Related laws — Yule–Simon tail
milestones.milestone_description: The tail frequencies of the Yule–Simon distribution are approximately $f(k;\rho)\approx[\text{constant}]/k^{\rho+1}$ for any choice of $\rho>0$ (source, \"Related laws\").

milestones.title: Statistical explanations — random typing (Li 1992)
milestones.milestone_description: In a document in which each character has been chosen randomly from a uniform distribution of all letters (plus a space character), the words follow the macro-trend of Zipf's law (source, \"Statistical explanations\", ref. [20] Li 1992).

milestones.title: Related laws — connection with Benford's law
milestones.milestone_description: The leading digits of data satisfying Zipf's law with $s=1$ satisfy Benford's law (source, \"Related laws\").
